classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to monitoring by the SlowMist security team, the staking and lending protocol HFLH on BNB Chain has been attacked. Users are advised to stay vigilant.

descriptions.text: According to monitoring by the SlowMist security team, the staking and lending protocol HFLH on BNB Chain has been attacked. Users are advised to stay vigilant.
HFLH (HFLH) was suspected to have been attacked on BNB, resulting in a loss of approximately $5,300.
